dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: All I know is that selling tea isn't enough. I've still got to live...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you're worried about something?

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: Fewer and fewer people are fishing... Or to be precise, far fewer youths are willing to engage in agriculture nowadays.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: Tea does bring in a lot of money, of course, but you can't just bite and eat Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: As far as I know, Qiaoying Village's grain production is barely self-sufficient, but many other crops must be purchased from outside.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: We're situated in the mountains, so if anything were to happen to the mountain path and stop the delivery of goods, now that be terrible news for us, wouldn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: What's more, youngsters nowadays are all busy learning how to grow and prepare tea.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: It worries me terribly. Fewer and fewer fishermen like me, youngsters unwilling to take up grain production... Won't our local produce soon come to lack variety?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: *sigh* What to do, what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really care about everyone, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: The people in our village are a good lot, and the tea they produce is precious. I can't stand to see good people and precious things suffer.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: A place gains stability from the balance of its produce. I hope more youngsters will realize this...

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: And stop focusing on just growing and selling tea, but consider the future of the entire village.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: I'll talk to Uncle Luo about my suggestions some other day...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: Oh? Outsiders, are you? Hello there, greetings!

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: As you can see, I'm just a plain fisherman, barely scraping by...

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: But I feel blessed to be able to fish in a place as pristine as Chenyu Vale.

dialogues.speaker: Chubo
dialogues.text: If you like fishing too, I can recommend several good spots where you can catch tasty fish!
